description: This file defines a controller class 'Information' within the OpenCart admin module for handling information tasks such as generating lists, individual info files, and clearing cached data. It interacts with models related to information, stores, and tasks, and provides endpoints for task management and file generation.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing information-related tasks within the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods to generate task lists, produce JSON files for individual information entries, and clearing stored data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of information tasks: clearing old data, listing all information entries, and scheduling tasks for each information item.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON file containing summaries of all information entries, including descriptions, and saves it to the server.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed JSON files for a specific information entry identified by 'information_id' and saves it.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the cached JSON data file for information listing.
